rules.quote: Abbreviations should be defined at first mention

rules.quote: Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.

rules.quote: should be placed in a separate section on the title page.
rules.requirement: Place acknowledgments on the title page.

rules.quote: encouraged to follow official APA version 7 guidelines
rules.requirement: Follow APA 7 guidance for reference-list authors when possible.

rules.quote: show how to apply learning methods to solve important applications problems
rules.requirement: For application work, show how learning methods solve the stated problem.

rules.quote: The affiliation(s) of the author(s), i.e. institution, (department), city, (state), country

rules.quote: The name(s) of the author(s)

rules.quote: Cite references in the text by name and year in parentheses.
rules.requirement: Use author year in text citations.

rules.quote: provide solid support via empirical studies, theoretical analysis, or comparison to psychological phenomena
rules.requirement: Support claims about learning problems or methods with suitable evidence.

rules.quote: Authors are required to disclose financial or non-financial interests
rules.requirement: Disclose relevant financial and nonfinancial interests.

rules.quote: provides a significant contribution beyond the conference paper
rules.requirement: A conference extension must make a significant new contribution.

rules.quote: overlap is described clearly at the beginning of the journal submission
rules.requirement: Describe overlap with a prior conference paper near the beginning.

rules.quote: place their contribution clearly in the context of existing work
rules.requirement: Situate the contribution relative to existing machine learning work.

rules.quote: must be accompanied by a 1-2 page information sheet
rules.requirement: Provide the separate 1-2-page MLJ contribution information sheet; this is a submission artifact, not a manuscript-text check.

rules.quote: What is the evidence you provide to support your claim?
rules.requirement: Summarize precise supporting evidence in the contribution sheet.

rules.quote: What is the main claim of the paper?
rules.requirement: Describe the main claim and its importance in the contribution sheet.

rules.quote: What papers by other authors make the most closely related contributions
rules.requirement: Identify closest related work in the contribution sheet.

rules.quote: All papers must state their contributions clearly
rules.requirement: State the paper contributions clearly.

rules.quote: A clear indication and an active e-mail address of the corresponding author
rules.requirement: Identify the corresponding author and an active email address.

rules.quote: explain how to access data supporting the results and analysis
rules.requirement: Explain access to supporting data.

rules.quote: All original research must include a data availability statement.
rules.requirement: Include a data availability statement for original research.

rules.quote: cite any publicly available data on which the conclusions of the paper rely
rules.requirement: Cite public supporting datasets.

rules.quote: under the heading "Statements and Declarations"
rules.requirement: Confirm heading: this page also calls for a Declarations section before references.

rules.quote: include DOIs as full DOI links in your reference list
rules.requirement: Use full DOI links where available.

rules.quote: provide all relevant editable source files at every submission and revision
rules.requirement: Provide complete editable sources.

rules.quote: Each figure should have a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide figure captions.

rules.quote: Figures should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite figures consecutively.

rules.quote: All figures are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number figures with Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: Always use footnotes instead of endnotes.
rules.requirement: Use footnotes rather than endnotes.

rules.quote: information regarding sources of funding
rules.requirement: Disclose funding where applicable.

rules.quote: decimal system of headings with no more than three levels
rules.requirement: Use no more than three numbered heading levels.

rules.quote: informed consent if the research involved human participants
rules.requirement: Include consent details if human participants are involved.

rules.quote: reviewers will expect these answers to be part of the introductory material of your paper
rules.requirement: Include claim, importance, evidence, and related work in the introduction.

rules.requirement: Confirm preferred file format because Word files are also accepted.

rules.requirement: Describe the learning component clearly.

rules.requirement: Do not list LLMs as authors.

rules.quote: improve how machine learning research is conducted

rules.quote: alphabetized by the last names of the first author

rules.quote: Have you published parts of your paper before
rules.requirement: Disclose prior publication of portions of the submission.

rules.requirement: Provide a caption for each supplementary item.

rules.requirement: Cite supplementary items in the manuscript.

rules.requirement: Cite tables consecutively.

rules.quote: All tables are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number tables with Arabic numerals.
